Title: Apple Pork Tenderloin
Ingredients: 2 pork tenderloins; 3 Granny Smith apples; 30 cl apple juice; 50 g hazelnuts; 1 pinch dried chili pepper; 50 g + 60 g butter; Salt
Recipe: Trim the pork tenderloins and cut them into medallions (grenadins). Cut the apples into quarters and core them. In a skillet, sauté the tenderloins with the apples in 50 g of butter for 10 minutes over low heat, turning them regularly. Deglaze with the apple juice, reduce by half, and add 60 g of cold butter. Emulsify by bringing to a boil. Sprinkle with roughly crushed hazelnuts and chili. Season with salt.

Title: Lemongrass Pork Linguine
Ingredients: 500 g pork tenderloin; 200 g linguine; 2 bay leaves; 2 lemongrass stalks; Peel of 1 lemon; 1 red chili pepper; 60 cl vegetable broth; 20 cl heavy cream; 1 red onion; 2 garlic cloves; 3 tbsp olive oil; Salt, pepper
Recipe: Peel and slice the red onion and garlic. Cut the lemongrass in half. Roughly slice the chili pepper. Cut the pork into thin strips. In a frying pan, sauté the onion in olive oil with the garlic, lemongrass, chili, bay leaves, and lemon peel for 5 minutes. Moisten with the broth and bring to a boil. Add the linguine and stir for 3 minutes. Add the meat and cream, and continue cooking according to the time indicated on the pasta package. Season.

Title: Cochinchine Pork
Ingredients: 500 g pork shoulder/collar; 80 g Chinese vermicelli; 50 g dried wood ear mushrooms; 2 carrots; 30 g salted peanuts; 1 lemongrass stalk; 2 shallots; 4 garlic cloves; 3 tbsp sesame oil; 1 tbsp brown sugar; 2 tbsp soy sauce; ½ bunch parsley; Salt, pepper
Recipe: In a non-stick frying pan, boil 1 cm of water with the mushrooms for 5 minutes. Turn off the heat, add the vermicelli, and leave for 3 minutes. Drain. Peel and slice the garlic, shallots, and lemongrass. Peel and cut the carrots into thin matchsticks, then slice the pork into strips. In the same pan, sauté the pork in sesame oil with the shallots, carrots, garlic, peanuts, and lemongrass. Pour in the sugar and cook over low heat for 5 minutes. Add the soy sauce, vermicelli, and mushrooms, and cook for an additional 5 minutes. Sprinkle with parsley leaves and season.

Title: Pineapple Chili Pork
Ingredients: 600 g pork shoulder/collar; 1 small pineapple; 3 onions; 1 red chili pepper; 1 green chili pepper; 10 cl white wine; 3 tbsp tamarind sauce; 50 g butter; 2 tbsp olive oil; Salt
Recipe: Cut the pork shoulder into small 2 cm cubes. Finely chop the chili peppers. Peel and slice the onions. Peel the pineapple, remove the eyes, and cut it into cubes the same size as the meat. In a frying pan, sauté the onions with the pork in a mixture of butter and olive oil for 10 minutes, browning them well. Add the pineapple and chili peppers, moisten with white wine, pour in the tamarind sauce, and cook for another 20 minutes until the liquid evaporates completely. Season with salt.

Title: Pork Chop Spinach Pickle
Ingredients: 4 pork chops; 1 kg baby spinach leaves; 50 g gherkins/pickles; 3 onions; 10 cl Muscat wine; 20 cl heavy cream; 30 g butter; 1 tbsp olive oil; Salt, pepper
Recipe: Peel and finely chop the onions. Slice the gherkins lengthwise. Rinse the baby spinach leaves. In a frying pan, cook the pork chops in butter and oil for 10 minutes on each side. Remove the chops and set them aside on a plate. Add the onions to the pan, let them brown, deglaze with Muscat, then add the spinach and cream. Season, reheat the chops in this mixture for 5 minutes, and add the gherkins before serving.

Title: Pork Shoulder Dried Fruit
Ingredients: 4 pork shoulder steaks; 2 onions; 50 g dried figs; 50 g prunes; 50 g dried cranberries; 200 g red kuri squash; 1 sprig rosemary; 15 cl orange juice; 50 g butter; 3 tbsp olive oil; Salt, pepper
Recipe: Cut the figs and prunes in half. Peel the squash and cut into chunks. Peel and slice the onions. In a pan, brown the pork steaks in oil with the rosemary, onions, and squash for 10 minutes on each side. Set the meat aside on a plate. Add the dried fruits to the pan, deglaze with orange juice, and mix. Cook for 5 minutes, add the butter, and return the pork steaks to the pan. Coat with sauce and season.

Title: Rosemary Tofu Quinoa
Ingredients: 200 g tofu; 150 g quinoa; 1 shallot; 1 carrot; 1 sprig rosemary; 1 small zucchini; 40 cl vegetable broth; 50 g butter; 10 cl heavy cream; Salt, pepper
Recipe: Peel and slice the shallot. Peel the carrot and cut it, along with the zucchini, into small cubes. In a non-stick pan, sauté the vegetables in butter, then add the quinoa, tofu, and rosemary. Moisten with the broth and cook for 15 minutes, stirring regularly. Add the cream and season.

Title: Veggie Quinoa with Cream Quenelle
Ingredients: 200 g quinoa; 3 shallots; 2 celery stalks; 2 sprigs flat-leaf parsley; 3 sprigs dill; 50 cl vegetable broth; 3 tbsp olive oil; 1 tbsp thick heavy cream/crème fraîche; 1 tsp paprika; Salt, pepper
Recipe: Peel and finely chop the shallots. Finely chop the celery along with its leaves, as well as the parsley and dill. In a non-stick pan, sauté the celery and shallots in olive oil over low heat for 5 minutes. Add the quinoa and let it brown for 2 minutes. Moisten with broth and cook over low heat for 15 minutes until the quinoa is tender. Season. Add the dill and parsley, top with a quenelle of thick cream, and sprinkle with paprika.

Title: Pumpkin Radish Tofu
Ingredients: 1 bunch pink radishes; 200 g pumpkin; 100 g smoked tofu; 1 tbsp green peppercorns in vinegar; 1 tbsp honey; 3 shallots; 60 g butter; 30 cl vegetable broth; Salt
Recipe: Cut the radishes, keeping 1 cm of greens. Peel the pumpkin and cut it into pieces. Peel and roughly slice the shallots. Cut the tofu into 1 cm cubes. Place the vegetables in a pan, cover them with broth, add the butter and honey, and let reduce until completely evaporated. Add the tofu and green peppercorns, then cook for an additional 5 minutes. Season with salt.

Title: Mascarpone Potato
Ingredients: 4 large Bintje-type potatoes; 150 g mascarpone; 1 yogurt; 1 bunch chives; 3 tbsp olive oil; 50 g butter; 30 cl vegetable broth; Fleur de sel
Recipe: Peel the potatoes and place them between two clean pencils. Make hasselback cuts into them with a knife down to the level of the pencils. In a non-stick pan, heat the butter. Cook the potatoes on the cut side for 5 minutes. Turn them over and cook for another 5 minutes. Moisten with vegetable broth, cover, and cook over low heat for 10 minutes. Mix the mascarpone and yogurt, add the chopped chives and olive oil, and season. Top the potatoes with this mixture.

Title: Herb Potatoes
Ingredients: 500 g fingerling potatoes (rattes); 6 garlic cloves; 2 shallots; 6 sprigs chives; 10 basil leaves; 6 sprigs cilantro; 1 bay leaf; 1 sprig fresh thyme; 6 tbsp olive oil; Fleur de sel
Recipe: Peel and slice the shallots. Roughly chop the chives, basil, and cilantro. Wash and dry the fingerling potatoes. In a pan, sauté the garlic cloves, shallots, bay leaf, and thyme in oil over low heat for 5 minutes. Add the potatoes and brown them for 5 to 10 minutes. Cover and cook over low heat for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally until tender. Add the herbs and salt, then serve.

Title: Asparagus Goat Cheese Bulgur
Ingredients: 250 g bulgur; 2 shallots; 1 pinch saffron; 37.5 cl vegetable broth; 4 green asparagus spears; 2 Chavignol goat cheese rounds; 6 sprigs chives; 2 tbsp olive oil; Salt, pepper
Recipe: Cut the asparagus into thin rounds and the goat cheese into strips. Peel and finely chop the shallots. In a non-stick pan, gently sauté the shallots in olive oil and add the bulgur. Let it brown. Moisten with vegetable broth, then add the saffron. Cook according to the package instructions, add the asparagus, stir, and cook for another 5 minutes. Season, arrange the goat cheese slices, and sprinkle with chives.

Title: Butternut Tofu Bulgur
Ingredients: 100 g bulgur; 1 shallot; 200 g butternut squash; 100 g tofu; 1 tsp Herbes de Provence; 1 lemon; 200 g vegetable broth; 2 tbsp olive oil; Salt, pepper
Recipe: Peel and finely chop the shallot. Peel and cut the squash into small 1 cm cubes; do the same with the tofu. In a pan, sauté the shallot and squash in olive oil. Add the bulgur and Herbes de Provence, moisten with vegetable broth, and cook for 10 minutes. Zest and juice the lemon. Add both to the mixture and season.

Title: Vegetable Risotto
Ingredients: 300 g arborio rice; 1 carrot; 1 zucchini; 1 red bell pepper; 1 celery stalk; 3 garlic cloves; 60 cl vegetable broth; 50 g butter; 80 g parmesan cheese; Salt, pepper
Recipe: Peel the carrot and slice into rounds. Slice the zucchini, celery, and bell pepper into small cubes. Peel and finely chop the garlic. In a non-stick pan, sauté all the vegetables with the garlic in butter for 5 minutes. Add the rice and gradually ladle in the broth until the rice is cooked, about 20 minutes. Season and sprinkle with grated parmesan.

Title: Endive Roquefort
Ingredients: 4 nice pale endives; 60 g Roquefort cheese; 50 g hazelnuts; 20 cl vegetable broth; 6 sprigs chives; 5 tbsp olive oil; Salt, pepper
Recipe: Finely chop the chives. Cut the endives into quarters lengthwise. Crumble the Roquefort. Roughly crush the hazelnuts. In a non-stick pan, brown the endives in olive oil over high heat. Moisten with vegetable broth and allow to evaporate completely. Add the crumbled Roquefort, crushed hazelnuts, and chives, then season.

Title: Zucchini Curry
Ingredients: 500 g round zucchinis; 2 onions; 1 pinch saffron; 1 orange; 20 cl coconut milk; 2 tbsp olive oil; Salt, pepper
Recipe: Peel and finely chop the onions. Cut the round zucchinis into quarters. Zest and juice the orange. In a pan, sauté the onions in olive oil, add the zucchinis and orange juice, and let reduce. Moisten with coconut milk, add the saffron and orange zest, then season.

Title: Green Vegetables Trofie
Ingredients: 150 g trofie pasta; 150 g fresh shelled peas; 150 g snow peas; 3 garlic cloves; 1 onion; 50 g almonds; 50 g dried cranberries; 50 cl vegetable broth; 3 tbsp olive oil; Salt, pepper
Recipe: Peel and slice the garlic and onion. String the snow peas. Roughly chop the almonds. In a non-stick pan, sauté the garlic and onion in oil over low heat. Moisten with broth, add the snow peas, and cook for 5 minutes. Add the trofie, cook for another 5 minutes, then add the peas and cranberries. Cook for an additional 5 minutes and season. Sprinkle with almonds before serving.

Title: Brussels Sprouts Feta Raisin
Ingredients: 400 g Brussels sprouts; 100 g feta cheese; 50 g golden raisins; 10 cl vegetable broth; 3 tbsp olive oil; Salt, pepper
Recipe: Halve the Brussels sprouts and rinse them. Cut the feta into 1 cm cubes. In a pan, sauté the Brussels sprouts over low heat to glaze them. Add the vegetable broth and raisins, and cook over low heat for 10 minutes. Season and add the feta before serving.

Title: Eggplant Hazelnut Coriander
Ingredients: 1 black eggplant; 1 pink eggplant; 1 white eggplant; 3 onions; 50 g hazelnuts; 3 sprigs cilantro; 10 cl olive oil; Fleur de sel
Recipe: Cut the eggplants into 1 cm cubes. Peel the onions and cut into quarters. Roughly crush the hazelnuts. In a pan, sauté the eggplant cubes in olive oil with the onions. Let cook over low heat for 20 minutes, add the hazelnuts, and cook for another 5 minutes. Season and sprinkle with cilantro leaves before serving.

Title: Eggplant Tomato Black Olive
Ingredients: 2 black eggplants; 200 g cherry tomatoes; 50 g Greek-style black olives; 3 onions; 3 garlic cloves; 10 cl olive oil; 4 sprigs mint; 1 tbsp pepper; Salt
Recipe: Cut the eggplants into 1 cm cubes. Cut the cherry tomatoes and olives in half. Peel and roughly slice the onions and garlic. In a pan, sauté the eggplants with the olives, onions, and garlic for 15 minutes. Add the cherry tomatoes and cook for another 10 minutes. Season and add fresh mint leaves.

Title: Egg Salmon Dill
Ingredients: 4 eggs; 2 slices smoked salmon; 3 sprigs dill; 80 g mascarpone; 1 onion; 2 tbsp olive oil; Fleur de sel
Recipe: Peel and slice the onion. In a non-stick pan, sauté the onion in oil over low heat for 5 minutes. Crack the eggs, add the smoked salmon cut into strips, and cook for another 3 minutes. Season and sprinkle with dill sprigs. Serve with a quenelle of mascarpone.

Title: Egg Crouton Fourme Cheese
Ingredients: 4 eggs; 2 slices dark bread; 80 g Fourme d'Ambert cheese; 4 sprigs chives; 50 g butter; Salt, pepper
Recipe: Finely chop the chives. Cut the bread and cheese into small cubes. In a non-stick pan, sauté the croutons in butter for 2 minutes. Crack the eggs and immediately cover with the cheese cubes. Cook over low heat for 3 minutes, season, and sprinkle with chives.

Title: Bell Pepper Egg
Ingredients: 4 eggs; 1 red bell pepper; ½ green bell pepper; ½ yellow bell pepper; 1 onion; 3 tbsp olive oil; Salt, pepper
Recipe: Cut 4 nice thick rings from the red bell pepper. Dice the rest of the peppers. Peel and slice the onion. In a non-stick pan, sauté the diced peppers, onion, and red pepper rings in oil over low heat for 7 minutes. Crack the eggs inside the pepper rings and cook for another 3 minutes. Season.

Title: British Egg
Ingredients: 4 eggs; 8 thin slices smoked bacon; 12 vine cherry tomatoes; 12 button mushrooms; 50 g butter; Salt, pepper
Recipe: Quarter the mushrooms. In a non-stick pan, sauté the bacon with the mushrooms and tomatoes in butter over low heat for 7 minutes. Push them to the side of the pan, crack the eggs, and cook for 3 minutes. Season.

Title: Hake Pilaf Rice
Ingredients: 4 hake fillets; 200 g basmati rice; 1 onion; 1 garlic clove; 50 cl vegetable broth; 3 tbsp olive oil; 30 g butter; Salt, pepper
Recipe: Peel and chop the onion and garlic. In a pan, sauté the onion and garlic in 1 tbsp olive oil and the butter. Add the rice and cook until translucent. Moisten with vegetable broth, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. In another pan, cook the hake fillets in the remaining olive oil for 4 minutes on each side. Season and serve with pilaf rice.

Title: Chorizo Mussels
Ingredients: 1 kg mussels; 100 g chorizo; 1 onion; 2 garlic cloves; 10 cl white wine; 2 tbsp olive oil; 4 sprigs parsley; Salt, pepper
Recipe: Clean and scrub the mussels. Peel and chop the onion and garlic. Dice the chorizo. In a large pan or Dutch oven, sauté the onion, garlic, and chorizo in olive oil for 5 minutes. Add the mussels, pour in the white wine, cover, and cook over high heat for 5 minutes until the mussels open. Sprinkle with chopped parsley and season.

Title: Hake Bell Pepper
Ingredients: 4 hake fillets; 1 red bell pepper; 1 yellow bell pepper; 1 onion; 2 garlic cloves; 3 tbsp olive oil; Salt, pepper
Recipe: Peel and slice the onion and garlic. Deseed and cut the bell peppers into strips. In a pan, sauté the onion, garlic, and peppers in 2 tbsp olive oil for 15 minutes until tender. Push to one side of the pan and cook the hake fillets in the remaining olive oil for 4 minutes on each side. Season.

Title: Scallop Butternut Squash
Ingredients: 12 sea scallops; 400 g butternut squash; 1 shallot; 40 g butter; 2 tbsp olive oil; Salt, pepper
Recipe: Peel the squash and cut into small cubes. Peel and chop the shallot. In a pan, sauté the shallot and squash in 20 g butter and olive oil over low heat for 15 minutes until tender. In another very hot pan, sear the scallops in the remaining butter for 1 to 2 minutes on each side. Season and serve immediately with the squash.

Title: Scallop Leek
Ingredients: 12 sea scallops; 3 leeks; 1 shallot; 20 cl heavy cream; 40 g butter; 1 tbsp olive oil; Salt, pepper
Recipe: Clean and slice the leeks. Peel and chop the shallot. In a pan, sauté the shallot and leeks in 20 g butter for 15 minutes. Add the heavy cream and reduce by half. In another hot pan, sear the scallops in the remaining butter and olive oil for 1 to 2 minutes per side. Season and serve the leek fondue topped with the scallops.

Title: Cod Fennel Citrus
Ingredients: 4 cod loins; 2 fennel bulbs; 1 orange; 1 grapefruit; 3 tbsp olive oil; Salt, pepper
Recipe: Finely slice the fennel. Segment the orange and grapefruit, reserving the juice. In a pan, sauté the fennel in 2 tbsp olive oil for 15 minutes. Add the citrus juice and reduce. Cook the cod loins in the remaining olive oil for 4 minutes on each side. Add the citrus segments at the end of cooking, season, and serve.

Title: Salmon Tagliatelle
Ingredients: 4 salmon fillets; 250 g tagliatelle; 20 cl heavy cream; 1 lemon; 4 sprigs dill; 2 tbsp olive oil; Salt, pepper
Recipe: Cook the tagliatelle according to package instructions. In a pan, cook the salmon fillets in olive oil for 4 to 5 minutes on each side. In a saucepan, heat the cream with the lemon juice and chopped dill. Drain the pasta, toss with the lemon-cream sauce, season, and serve with the salmon fillets.

Title: Pork Tenderloin Prunes
Ingredients: 2 pork tenderloins; 150 g pitted prunes; 2 onions; 15 cl white wine; 30 g butter; 2 tbsp olive oil; Salt, pepper
Recipe: Cut the pork tenderloins into medallions. Peel and slice the onions. In a pan, brown the meat in butter and olive oil for 5 minutes on each side, then set aside. In the same pan, sauté the onions, add the prunes, and deglaze with white wine. Return the meat to the pan and simmer over low heat for 15 minutes. Season.
